text:
maya.s: Reminder: third-party pen test (BlackOak) kickoff Fri 09:00 PT. Finalizing scope: RBAC ephemeral roles, KMS presign flow, and audit latency SLA.

rahul.k: Prefer RBAC change window 08:30-10:30 PT (2h). Who is authorized to approve emergency elevates? Need named eng leads.

jin.w: I'll set up the ephemeral-role bake and test presign lambda against the staging KMS replica. Presign uses GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + Sign. Do not grant Decrypt to assessor principals.

sam.t: We need an evidence export guardrail: presign lambda role only, S3 bucket allow-list, and short TTL (15m) for presigned URLs. Jin, can you add example policy in the runbook?

jin.w: Yes. Will include this snippet in runbook (example):
# presign lambda policy excerpt
Effect: Allow
Action: [kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:Sign, s3:PutObject]
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/EXAMPLE

maya.s: Intake flow: vendor findings should auto-create issues in project pen-2026-q2. Intake form must capture severity, repro steps, owner, requires-kms-review flag. High severity with kms flag should page KMS SME.

rahul.k: Also tag issues with `rbac` when role changes are implicated. Add a GH label mapping in the webhook.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] scheduled: ephemeral/assessor-bake-20260410T07:00Z -> expires 20260410T11:00Z.

sam.t: Retest plan: reserve 4h window 7 days after fix. Ops to snapshot env and keystore state; snapshots retained 72h.

jin.w: Runbook actions will include: `keystorectl snapshot --id $RUN_ID` and cloudtrail validation command to search for Decrypt events from assessor principal. Example: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-blackoak | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'

maya.s: IR rule: if vendor demonstrates exploit chain, escalate to oncall-SOC and open #incidents immediately. That path is outside the normal retest flow. Include SOC contact card in runbook.

rahul.k: I'll own escalation mapping and label-to-pager rules.

jin.w: Action: publish runbook + intake form webhook by EOD tomorrow. Will post link here.

maya.s: Owners: Jin (runbook + form + presign policy), Rahul (escalation + labels + approvers list), Sam (reserve retest window + snapshot policy). Thanks, closing thread and will share runbook link once available. :thumbsup:
